examples.review_text: I didn’t love this enough to buy again. It reminded me of the st. Ives apricot scrub. I don’t tend to use physical exfoliators and didn’t see a large enough difference to switch

examples.review_title: Wouldn’t buy again but not bad
examples.review_text: It did brighten my skin for a couple of days but made me break out in a few spots.
Product feels really heavy, I prefer the YTTP clay mask.

I wanted to give this product some time to really see any changes. The product goes on smoothly and a little goes a long way. It did seem to give my skin a more tightened appearance. Unfortunately every time I used this product it caused me to break out. It also dried out my skin. I switched to only using it on my forehead. I don’t think the results are noticeable and at this price I would not repurchase. I will continue to use the remainder of this product and update this review if I observe more positive changes. I received this product complimentary through @Influenster and Kate Somerville.

Out of all the products I was sent this would be my favorite. This product definitely brightened and softened my skin but I wish it would’ve done everything it said it could do. Also the process and steps for these products can get confusing so I also don’t like that part. And I did feel some tingling when applying but mixed with the other products the tingling subsided. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I read many reviews and finally decided to buy this cleanser. My purpose of getting this is to remove my makeup while cleaning a face like 2 in 1 thing. Although quite a bit of people wrote that this cleanser removes all the makeup even mascara and so on. It DOES NOT remove mascara!!! I posted the picture of my eyelashes after using this product. This is just a cleanser, not a makeup remover/cleanser. I’m not sure whether this is a good cleanser like other people say or not since I use a toner, serum and moisturizer right after. Please do not hope this removes makeup as well! That’s not true, at least to me.
Nothing special but for the price sure why not. I would recommend the aveno brand for sensitive skin.

I just wasn’t a big fan & that is probably just because it is oil based. It did an okay job at cleaning my my face and I didn’t like how my face felt afterwards (again due to the oil). However, with that being said it definitely did not strip my face or leave it feeling dry!
Not impressed. Pixie spray more than half the price blows this away.

examples.review_title: I love Caudalie but the smell and tacky...
examples.review_text: I love the texture of this cream. I need it for my dry skin, but surprisingly it just sits on my skin. It does not absorb very well. This cream has a strong smell and it is tacky. My face looks a bit greasy and is sticky. I am going to return it.

Huge no for me . It helped moisturizer , but didn’t do much else for my skin. It is extremely greasy and pills up if you rub your face after putting it on. Has a very strong orange scent so watch out people with sensitive skin.
I’ve been using this product for a month and haven’t noticed any difference, if anything it’s slowed down the life time of my black heads. Really odd.

I’ve used it for 2 months now and don’t really notice any difference. I’m also not a fan of the sticky and shiny finish it has on my face. Will prob finish the bottle since it’s so expensive but wouldn’t purchase again.

This balm was no where near as hydrating or moisturizing for my lips as other reviews made it seem. It felt fine while it was on but as it wore off my lips felt dryer than before I put it on. Not worth the price in my opinion. It was basically a clear lip gloss for me since I didn’t receive any lip balm benefits from the product. I would rather go back to the FAB lip balm or the Auquaphor lip balm sold at the drugstore than to repurchase this or any other balm from this brand. Not worth the money
examples._label: ★☆☆☆☆  ·  does NOT recommend  ·  Lip Balms & Treatments

examples.review_text: Doesn’t do anything,It doesn’t harm but nothing shows neither.
Makes my skin feel really gross and oily. After washing my face after using this, it still didn’t feel completely normal right away

Terrible. I never burn when I apply sunscreen so I assumed a product with SPF 50 I thought I was safe. Not the case- both my husband and I got badly burned, and we were only in the sun 45 minutes. It’s a week later and I am finally peeling but I am very upset for wasting money and it ruining my beach vacation. AVOID!!!!!!

This new formula is awful. I’ve been using the original SPF 15 version for over 5 years and it was my absolute holy grail product. I picked up the new formula the other day and was so disappointed. The product immediately caused my makeup to pill and left me looking oily less than an hour after application. I’ve used the product for over a week now in hopes of finding a way to make it work, but haven’t had any luck. I really don’t see any oil control with this product and it causes my makeup to break apart. Please bring back the old version!

I was searching for a new daily moisturizer so thought I’d give this a try. I have sensitive skin and this burns when I put it on. The fragrance is terrible. It reminds of office bathroom air freshener. I do not like this product.
Sephora, you need to curate your SPF? What skin respecting brand would put BERGAMOT OIL in an SPF, especially with marketing geared toward a more melasma prone demographic. I’m honestly shocked.
Fell in love after receiving a 1.5 oz in an ipsy box. It has a light but invigorating lemon scent. Leaves my face and neck feeling clean and fresh and

examples.review_title: Great for oily skin and smells amazing!
examples.review_text: I received this last week and it’s all I want to use! I have very oily skin and many foaming cleansers leave my face feeling very dry and tight but this did not! The smell is amazing and I honestly look forward to washing my face because of it (even after a 12+ hour hospital shift when I feel like a zombie!) I have not used many of Ole’s products but I will definitely buy this again.

I really like this Acne Clearing Wash because it really does the job!!  It makes my skin feel so clean and refreshed after every use and it keeps my acne at bay every month.  I break out around my time of the month and I notice that my acne isn’t as severe as it has been.  This is my go-to face wash for managing my acne and I am so happy I tried this product, it’s my new favorite.

I have been using this cream for 5 days. It’s cooling, moisturizing and very lightweight. I keep it in the fridge and love the touch of the  frozen metal early in the morning:) I have got really bad eye bags and discoloration especially after I can’t get enough sleep. This cream is helping to depuff and I can even see the color under my eyes is a little bit lighter. Will definitely buy a new one when I run off.

I’ve tried many eye creams in my 56 years…I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks and for the skin around my eyes it works great to hydrate and plump.  It has a thick and creamy texture and when patted around the eye it it immediately soothing!
Love love love love love this. It’s all I use for moisturizer. Locks in moisture by day or night. I have very dry (+ combination at times), sensitive skin and this is a game-changer for me.
Is there a difference after using one? Yes. Can I afford to use it all the time? No. Lol. I will definitely stock a box or two during one of the sales throughout the year.

Sunday Riley’s Vitamin C oil, CEO Glow is the only Vitamin C product that I’ve sworn by ever since it’s launch. Now it has some stiff competition because this moisturizer is THAT GOOD. I love how absolutely radiant my skin has been looking ever since I’ve incorporated this into my morning routine.

I have been using this for about a week and have been loving it! Very hydrating and not irritating at all. Worth giving it a try in your skincare routine. Also love the fact that it is clean beauty and cruelty free!I received this product for free from Influenster and Tula
I have received this product for my honest review. I enjoyed using the product. It was great and I highly recommend this product.

This cream is absolutely my favorite! I have many skin concerns such as rosacea, adult acne, and very unpredictable sensitive skin. The first time I applied “IT“, it smelled a bit funny and seemed too oily for my skin but I gave it 8 hours (slept on it ;)!) and when I woke up my skin had transformed! It had nourished my skin, making it extremely dewy and vibrant and there was no sign of oiliness! I have been using his product since then! I highly recommend this to people who have skin concerns such as mine (unpredictable, very sensitive, and prone to adult acne).
Tried and true, erases anything! I put a blob on whatever spot the night before and by morning things always look good!

I’ve been using this product for about two weeks and can already see a difference in the size of my  pores and have noticed a slight difference in my pigmented areas. I have extremely sensitive skin and have not had any allergic or bad reaction to this serum. I struggle daily with rosacea and this has not caused it to flare up either. I also love the way my makeup looks when I apply it over , it leaves a smooth and clean look. And it even helps minimize the small wrinkles around my eyes!

I don’t usually like using peels because I do have very sensitive skin, however I decided to give this product a try and was not disappointed. Lately my skin has been breaking out and I noticed my pores looking bigger and some blackheads (eww) . After using these pads twice a week for 2 weeks I noticed a huge difference. My pores look smaller for a fact and my skin is starting to feel normal again , guess it helps really get rid of all impurities. I wouldn’t recommend using them daily specially if you have sensitive skin. Stick to 2-3 times a week. I received this product complimentary from influenster .
After using this product I saw immediate glow. As promised. It’s refreshing to have a product stick to what they say. I would highly recommend this product.

I started breaking out a few months back around my forehead and chin and my regular products weren’t doing anything else for me so I bought this in august. this past month has been the best I’ve seen my face all year. truly amazing product and the price!!! def buying again

I really like this cleanser! It foams up to a mousse like texture and is super soft. One thing I liked in particular is that it left my skin feeling super clean but did not leave it with the “tight skin“ feeling that you often get with other cleansers. However, if you don’t like scented skincare, this is not for you. It has kind of a milky lily scent that I didn’t mind but it might not be the case for others. All in all, I’m super satisfied :)

I loved the moisture this product provided and I did notice a reduction in fine lines. The packing is very creative with the twist top lid making it great for travel or on the go leak prevention. One of my favorite things is that this product is clean and safe for my skin. I would definitely recommend it to others as a safe product to add moisture and reduce fine lines.
Bought it in a mini version  Use it in the shower once a week. Clears pores very well. A little goes a long way.

examples.review_title: Amazing moisturizer that isn't super heavy
examples.review_text: I love and swear by The Inkey List products.  They work great and are affordable. the only reason I am giving this a 4/5 is it doesn’t smell the greatest.   It does a bit of that dermatologist medicated smell.   But that is easy enough to deal with as I also use the Herbivore Coconut water mist (which smells great)

I received this as a complimentary sample, in exchange for my honest review. Wow! I didn’t want to love it , but I do! It sits well below and on top of my makeup. I passed it forward to my mom (wished I didn’t) and she’s too obsessed for me to take it away from her lol. If you have the budget, I’d splurge, but my only compliant is the added parfum/fragrance (like why) although it is not irritating at all!
Love this! Very easy to apply. Love how it comes with a glove so it’s nice & easy to apply on your body.  Love how it makes my skin feel. Tan and just gives you this glow. This is very easy to apply!
